name: mailroom
description: Self-hosted Cloudflare Worker that gives AI agents, such as Claude, ChatGPT and Codex, access to multiple Gmail / Google Workspace mailboxes and their calendars.

scripts.dev: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local && wrangler dev
scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: A long passphrase that you choose, for example four random words. It unlocks the setup page and encrypts the stored Google credentials. **If you change it later, you must paste the Google client secret again and re-link each mailbox.**
